paragraphs: Receive invoices and receipts in the morning, enter them into the system, and confirm account classifications. Retrieve bank transactions in the afternoon and reconcile each item, tracing any imbalance to its source. Prepare for month-end close, organize working papers and retained documents, then review the task and anomaly lists before the next day's reconciliation.

In one sentence: turn documents into ledger entries. Work includes entering vouchers, reconciling bank activity, balancing accounts, and preserving workpapers. It combines hands-on work with close observation as the foundation of finance.

According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,613,400 bookkeeping, accounting, and auditing clerks were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 1,519,100 by 2034, a net decrease of about 94,300 jobs, with approximately 170,000 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $49,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).

AI will not replace Bookkeeping, accounting, and auditing clerks, but it will accelerate data entry and reconciliation. OCR, RPA, and centralized finance platforms speed up document recognition, posting, and reconciliation, shifting clerks from entering data toward investigating anomalies, applying consistent accounting policies, and maintaining compliant records. Data entry is accelerated most; people who find errors and understand compliance become more valuable.

paragraphs: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high AI-exposure range for data entry. Systems accelerate basic bookkeeping, while investigation and compliance remain human responsibilities.

Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Entering data and reconciling transactions are being replaced, not anomaly investigation and compliance work. People who find errors and understand compliance become scarcer as efficiency improves. Those limited to entering vouchers face the greatest risk.

Build a foundation through secondary vocational school or an associate degree in accounting, and develop systems skills and certifications while studying. Pure data-entry roles are shrinking in the AI era, so build investigation and compliance skills early.
Advance from entering vouchers to investigating anomalies and ensuring compliance. Learn centralized finance platforms and work toward general-ledger or audit roles.
Emphasize certifications and actual transaction volumes, and identify the systems you have used. Employers value accuracy and consistency.
Do not select candidates only for speed; assess how accurately they find errors. People who protect compliance are worth retaining.
